theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_extend_to_univ
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), X.support ⊆ K → X.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1), Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = X ∧ Y.support ⊆ K ∧ Y.mass ≤ X.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ X.boundary.mass ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y) ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X.boundary → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y.boundary)
